n33137.source: ⟨Demetrius⟩ Rhet., De elocutione, ed. William Rhys Roberts, Cambridge 1902 (Perseus)

n33138.source: Flavius Philostratus, Vita Apollonii, ed. Carl Ludwig Kayser, Leipzig 1870 (Perseus)

n33140.source: Aeschylus, Persae, ed. Herbert Weir Smyth, New York 1922 (Perseus)
